answer: Each agent locks non-transferable copper stake into a unique behavioral vault. A prism of independent peer clusters must co-attest every epoch of history; the stake weight is convex in the number of co-located identities. An attacker who fabricates many clones therefore multiplies both locked capital and the quorum load that must be satisfied before any influence can be claimed, with the total cost rising sharply as the coordinated set approaches the horizon of network control.
